The chrome toast rack with integral crumb tray allows you to cook fish, meats or melt cheese quickly and efficiently, while the adjustable height shelf ensures each item is cooked at the perfect temperature. With the Parry 7072 Gas Salamander Wall Grill you can make delicious meals in no time at all!
